digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent sync: outbound field diff and reconciliation pass
propositions: DC silently accepts and ignores PUT fields.parent on a sub-task; parent edit requests never reach the tracker for non-epic parent shapes.

rebar's _resolve_local_parent returns (False, None) for a bound non-epic parent with no log or alert, making emit-time suppression indistinguishable from retry-next-pass and structurally unreachable the bridge_alerts apparatus.

Two live round-trip cells have never passed because they assert operations on sub-task parent that DC cannot perform; re-homing them to Epic Link mechanism (green in the same run) preserves test subjects while aligning oracles to supported capabilities.
Setting a parent the tracker cannot represent for a child shape must produce a durable operator-visible record (bridge alert naming reason and alternative), not a silent no-op reporting success.
Emit-side suppression for unrepresentable parents must record the dropped field only when it actually differs from the remote value, not on every converged ticket that already holds the parent.
